description: Maximum horizontal span of a wood roof rafter from Table 9.23.4.2.-F of the 2024 Ontario Building Code for specified roof snow loads of 1.0 to 2.0 kPa. Source: Ontario Building Code 2024, Division B, Table 9.23.4.2.-F, Maximum Spans for Roof Rafters, Specified Roof Snow Loads 1.0 to 2.0 kPa.

snow_kpa.description: Specified roof snow load; the column at or above it is used. Unit: kPa.

spacing_mm.description: Spacing on centre (12, 16 and 24 in are also accepted). Unit: mm.

span_ft.description: Horizontal span between the inside faces of the supports in feet (or use span_m). Unit: ft.

span_in.description: Extra inches added to span_ft. Unit: in.

span_m.description: Horizontal span between the inside faces of the supports in metres, instead of span_ft. Unit: m.
